title: Get started with bootstrict
text: know four rules know every constructor package behaves: Naming. Every constructor snake_case, prefixed bs_ (bs_card(), bs_text_input(), …). Extra class values passed ... merged component’s classes. Interactive widgets take leading id. value available input$id, just like Shiny input. title: Content: tables, media and typography
text: bs_table() renders faithful Bootstrap <table class="table">. Pass data frame matrix first argument builds header body ; pass tag children instead hand-build rows. common form — styled data-frame table: accented variants Bootstrap tables page arguments rather classes remember, compose: row_variant recycled number rows, single value colours , NA leaves row alone. "active" accepted alongside theme colours. responsive = TRUE wraps table scrolls horizontally narrow screens (pass breakpoint ):
code: bs_table(   data = NULL,   ...,                 # manual children when `data` is NULL   striped = FALSE,     # TRUE / "rows", or "columns"   bordered = FALSE,    # borders on all sides   borderless = FALSE,  # remove all borders   hover = FALSE,       # hover highlight   small = FALSE,       # condensed padding   variant = NULL,      # a theme colour for the whole table   responsive = FALSE,  # TRUE, or a breakpoint "sm"/"md"/… for horizontal scroll   align = NULL,        # vertical alignment: "middle"/"top"/"bottom"   caption = NULL,   caption_top = FALSE, # put the caption above the table   head_variant = NULL, # a theme colour for the <thead>   group_divider = FALSE, # thicker border under the header   row_variant = NULL,  # per-row theme colour, recycled; NA leaves a row plain   rownames = NULL,     # row names as the reference <th scope="row">   class = NULL ) bs_table(head(mtcars), striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE) bs_table(   head(mtcars, 4),   head_variant = "dark",   group_divider = TRUE,   row_variant = c(NA, "success", NA, "danger"),   caption = "Four cars",   caption_top = TRUE ) bs_table(   df,   striped = TRUE,   small = TRUE,   responsive = TRUE,   caption = "24 matching events" )
